_doc: ONE PROGRESSION SYSTEM for the player and villagers (Steve 2026-10-14: 'I think we need to sync the player and villager system. But the villager system sounds like the better model.'). Deeds feed track XP; crossing a threshold is a level-up. Villagers take the next unheld kit ability (fixed order, no RNG) and learn the next track skill. The player gets a level-up sheet: pick 1 of the next 3 unheld kit abilities. Kits are MAGIC ONLY (lane 'magic'); human competences are the 'skills' lists (villagers learn them as skills, never in a slot). Read by src/js/tracks.js.
_playerScale: The player does far more deeds per day than a villager (a villager's day is one or two chores). Same tracks, same events, same kits; the player's thresholds are thresholds x playerScale. Tuned 2026-10-14 so a median 150-day capable run gets ~8 level-ups (evidence/2026-10-14/unified-tracks.md).
_kits: Power order, weakest first. Every magic ability sits in exactly one kit (fusion_reactor excluded: one per world, its own pellet offer). Villagers take kit[0], kit[1], ... at thresholds 1-5; the player is offered the next 3 unheld.
_skills: Human competences the track's work teaches a VILLAGER (lane 'skill' ability ids; stored by their codex skill id). One per threshold crossed, no slot, no System needed. The player learns skills through the codex/practice paths instead.
_skillLevels: Villagers learn a track skill only at these levels (2 and 4): the old kits gave one thing per threshold, and merged skills carry several abilities (track_read = tracker + game_sense + blood_trail), so a skill at every level made villager godhood pools trivial. Order puts the godhood cores first (diplomat, triage/field_medicine) so shepherd_of_the_dead and undying_ward stay reachable.
_deeds: Player deed table: noteDeed(id) credits {track, n}, at most perDay times a day (chores are decisions, not grinding). Villager sites call villagerGainXP(vid, track, n, why) with the same tracks; when the doer is the bearer, that credits the player.
_conversions: Deeds that used to GRANT a magic ability directly (trial-deeds, practice-deeds) now credit track XP once instead: the power comes from the track's level-up sheet.
